about_the_game:
A role-playing game in a manapunk setting where you decide who you want to be:
an ordinary villager? a monster hunter? or perhaps an adventurer exploring ancient dungeons in search of treasures and resources to craft powerful equipment?
The choice is yours.

You begin the game as a member of one of four clans, each with its own strengths. Your first goal is to earn money for your equipment — whether for fighting monsters or gathering resources. And the main city won’t let you in for free: entry requires payment. Yet inside lies the forge and the dungeon — the favorite place for true adventurers.

Key Features:

  • Freedom to choose your own path: villager, hunter, or dungeon explorer.

  • Exploration of an open world with a unique manapunk atmosphere.

  • Combat with monsters and resource gathering.

  • Crafting and upgrading equipment.

  • Four clans with distinct advantages.

  • An atmosphere of adventure and freedom where you write your own story.
